lessonTitle: 17. The limit of a sequence; the number e
lessonTitleEnglish: The limit of a sequence; the number e
unit: Algebra · Chapter 3. Logic; sequences and limits
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 11 mathematics textbooks (general stream)

stages.headline: a is the limit of aₙ (lim aₙ = a) if aₙ − a is infinitesimal; lim (n + 1)/n = 1 since (n + 1)/n − 1 = 1/n.
stages.headlineEnglish: a is the limit of aₙ (lim aₙ = a) if aₙ − a is infinitesimal; lim (n + 1)/n = 1 since (n + 1)/n − 1 = 1/n.

stages.headline: lim(aₙ ± bₙ) = a ± b, lim(aₙbₙ) = ab, lim(aₙ/bₙ) = a/b (b ≠ 0); a monotone bounded sequence has a limit.
stages.headlineEnglish: lim(aₙ ± bₙ) = a ± b, lim(aₙbₙ) = ab, lim(aₙ/bₙ) = a/b (b ≠ 0); a monotone bounded sequence has a limit.

stages.headline: The number e is the limit of (1 + 1/n)ⁿ: e ≈ 2.718.
stages.headlineEnglish: The number e is the limit of (1 + 1/n)ⁿ: e ≈ 2.718.
